lastCompletedStory.title: Regression test piping synthetic PreToolUse payloads to the real hook script

nextStoryContext:
US-003 created test/orch-agent-allowlist.test.ts: 11 tests using Bun.spawn against the real .claude/hooks/orch-agent-allowlist.sh, covering deny cases (general-purpose, Explore, missing/empty type), allow cases (subagent-planner, subagent-auditor), defensive fallback paths (tool_input.agent_type, top-level agent_type), and an empirically-observed production shape fixture (tool_input.subagent_type with a top-level agent_type=subagent-orchestrator). jq-absent CI skip pattern used (test.skipIf(!jqAvailable)). All 1387 tests pass.

US-004 (next story) ships .claude/settings.json and .claude/hooks/orch-agent-allowlist.sh to downstream projects via the cam init template system. Key files: src/templates/embedded.ts (SUBTREES, targetPath, materializeTemplates), scripts/generate-embedded-vendor.ts (already walks templates/ recursively so adding templates/.claude/ auto-embeds), test/embedded.test.ts (extend to assert the new keys exist in templatesContents). Main risk: executable bit - writeFileSync drops mode, init/materializeTemplates must chmod +x the hook after writing.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed: deny contract is exit 0 + JSON hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision=deny; top-level agent_type is caller identity not spawned type; tool_input.subagent_type is the primary spawned-type field.
Confirmed: stdin accepts TypedArray (Uint8Array is valid), proc.stdout is ReadableStream readable via new Response(proc.stdout).text(), proc.exited is Promise<number>. Implementation matches API.
